evals.prompt: Here are three photos of my two-storey house: the front from the street, the right side, and the back yard. The listing says 2,100 sq ft. Build it in Pascal so I can edit it.
evals.expected_output: Inventories the photos by facade, anchors scale on a door or storey, writes one brief with labelled estimates, checks the area against the listing before calling draft_building_from_brief, and reports the estimates, the area check and the unseen left facade.
expectations: Assigns each photo to front, right or back before estimating, and states that the left facade is not visible.
Gives the listing area as knownFloorArea with source measured, and no other value as measured.
Compares footprint area x storeys with the listing before the call and explains any gap over 10%.
Calls draft_building_from_brief once with the whole brief rather than building wall by wall.
Reports the returned estimates, floorArea check, skippedOpenings and limitations in plain words, and names the most useful next measurement.

evals.prompt: This is one street photo of a small shop with a flat roof. I have no measurements at all. Make a quick 3D draft.
evals.expected_output: Drafts from a single photo, scaling from the shop door, marks the depth as a low-confidence estimate or default, leaves unseen facades without openings, and says the model is a draft from one photo.
expectations: Uses a door or another standard element in the facade plane for scale and says which.
Gives the depth a low confidence (0.3 or less) and a basis, or leaves it to an explained default.
Does not invent openings on facades the photo does not show.
Uses roof type flat with no pitch.
States that every dimension is an estimate from one photo, not a measurement.

evals.prompt: Model this L-shaped ranch house from these drone photos and the lot plan I attached, which gives the outside dimensions.
evals.expected_output: Uses a polygon footprint from the lot plan with source measured, refers to facades by edge index, and reports that the roof covers the bounding rectangle of the L as a limitation to fix in the editor.
expectations: Uses a polygon footprint with outside corners, front edge first, anticlockwise on a north-up plan.
Marks the footprint as measured because it comes from the lot plan, and photo-derived heights as estimated.
Refers to polygon facades by edge index, not by front/right/back/left.
Relays the roof bounding-rectangle limitation rather than claiming an exact roof.

evals.prompt: Build my house from these photos into my existing Pascal project. It already has a garage I modeled last week.
evals.expected_output: Does not overwrite the existing building: on a building_not_empty refusal it explains the choice instead of clearing the project, and clears only if the user asks to start over.
expectations: Treats building_not_empty as an answer and does not call clear_scene unless the user asks to start over.
Offers a concrete option, such as a separate project for the draft, without deleting the garage.
